info.name: Little List API - QA suite
info.description: Contract, negative, boundary, auth, RLS, pagination, idempotency and robustness tests for the Little List backend (Supabase Auth + PostgREST). Generated by the QA suite in qa/api/. Set base_url, anon_key, email and password in the environment, then run the Login request first so access_token/uid are captured.

exec: pm.test("task fields present", () => { const row = pm.response.json()[0]; ["id","title","completed","priority","created_at"].forEach(f => pm.expect(row).to.have.property(f)); });

item.name: Second user sees only own tasks

exec: pm.test("no leakage of other users rows", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("sorted ascending", () => { const d = pm.response.json().map(r => r.due_date); pm.expect(d).to.eql([...d].sort()); });

item.name: Duplicate POST creates two rows (documents C-06 gap)

exec: pm.test("both accepted - no idempotency layer (documented gap)", () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
